description: From linuxmusterDEV/templates/renovate.json (supply chain, stage A): keep the SHA-pinned actions, the digest-pinned build image and the pinned Renovate engine current through reviewable PRs. Nothing is automerged.

customManagers.description: Build image pinned as <image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest> in the workflows (IMG_LMN73/IMG_LMN74 in ci.yml and release.yml). The captured tag tells Renovate which tag's digest to follow.
The Renovate engine itself, pinned as renovate-version: <version>@sha256:<digest> in renovate.yml (the action's default engine is too old for this config).
Pinned CI gate tools that ci.yml installs with `pip install tool==x.y.z` in the fast tier, so a linter widening its default rules cannot turn CI red on its own.

packageRules.description: Build image: never change the tag (24.04 -> 26.04 would be a new linuxmuster line, not an update), only follow its digest.
Build image digests in one PR, so ci.yml and release.yml always build with the same image. A human reviews and merges it.
Actions stay pinned by commit SHA with a # vN comment; a human merges every bump.
setup-python mirrors the target Ubuntu's Python (3.12 on 24.04 for lmn73); it changes with the linuxmuster line, not with Python releases.
Renovate engine: one PR that moves along until it is merged.
